description: Feeder tool for MCP directories and crawlers: page through OunceScout's full bullion catalog with live lowest verified delivered dealer prices, instead of querying product-by-product via search. Each priced item carries lowestPriceCheckedAt, lowestPriceVerificationMethod, and a labeled delivered-price composition; products without a verified in-stock offer checked within 24 hours carry a null price. Every result carries serve-time freshness stamps: checkedAt, priceAgeSeconds, and priceAgeBasis naming which price the age describes (priceAgeSeconds is null, with the basis explaining the data-as-of stamp, for tools that quote no price).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as nextCursor by a previous call (omit for the first page).

updatedSince.description: Optional ISO timestamp; only products updated after it are returned (incremental polling).
